title: Direct literature operating candidates for screw pressing and anaerobic digestion
license: Values and metadata are transcribed for research use; consult cited publisher articles for licensing and reuse terms.
runtime_policy: Candidates are available only in explicit literature_default or expert_override calculation modes. Existing workbook defaults remain unchanged. Literature quality (B) describes the evidence source, while proxy_high transferability and warnings describe its limits for Dutch roadside grass.

PRESS-001.applicability: Fresh primary-growth timothy before ensiling, single-screw pressing, with 0.4 L water per kg fresh grass added in first and second cycles; report is not roadside-grass data.
PRESS-001.conversion_method: Identity from table value 0.301 g liquid/g fresh sample; no conversion applied. Whether the separately added water is included in the denominator is not unambiguously resolved from the tabulated value.
PRESS-001.uncertainty: No uncertainty interval reported for this descriptive fresh-grass liquid yield.
PRESS-001.runtime_mapping: Optional F1 literature candidate for phase3.juice_yield_kg_per_kg_wet_feed. Requires explicit literature_default or expert_override mode; structural default remains unchanged.

AD-001.applicability: Semi-continuous CSTR digestion of grass silage at 35 degC, OLR 2 kg VS/m3/d and HRT 30 d.
AD-001.conversion_method: Direct setpoint transcription; no unit conversion.
AD-001.uncertainty: No uncertainty interval attached to these operating setpoints.
AD-001.runtime_mapping: Optional AD1 literature candidate. The study reports process instability under this initial operating combination; candidates are not recommended design setpoints.

AD-002.applicability: Semi-continuous CSTR digestion of grass silage at 35 degC and OLR 2 kg VS/m3/d.
AD-002.conversion_method: Direct setpoint transcription; no unit conversion.
